title: External Vault backup boundary verification
objective: Verify the intended external backup boundary for Donh91/Investering-Framework-Vault when repository/app access is available, without weakening the current fail-closed safety model or copying restricted material into the public control plane.
known_state: The restricted data plane is Donh91/secrets.
An external Vault repository is intended as a backup/safepoint boundary, but current connected GitHub access has not been sufficient to verify it as an independently reachable backup target.
Recent high-impact work has used internal safepoints and explicit external_vault_claimed_complete=false semantics rather than falsely claiming external backup completion.
required_evidence_to_unblock: Authenticated repository metadata proving the Vault repository is independently reachable.
A documented backup/safepoint receipt contract that distinguishes control plane, restricted data plane and external backup.
Proof that no secrets or restricted provider payloads are copied into the public control plane.
A restore/readback verification for any backup that is claimed complete.
guardrails: Do not work around missing access by making repositories public.
Do not copy secrets, raw restricted provider payloads or private normalized market data into the public repository.
Do not relabel an internal branch or public repository as an independently verified external backup.
Do not weaken fail-closed safepoint requirements merely to unblock unrelated PRs.
No Codex task should attempt to solve an authorization boundary with code unless access and contract evidence first prove a code defect.
clean_noop_condition: A newer canonical architecture explicitly retires the external Vault requirement and replaces it with an independently verified equivalent boundary.
